pages.title: stead.ai
pages.subtitle: Insured stock swaps that keep factories running through shipping delays.
pages.byline: UDI BAHAT, CEO  ·  RONIT OREN, PHD, CTO  ·  NOVEMBER 2026

pages.text: stead.ai keeps a factory running when its boxes run late. We spot the delay days early, find identical stock in a distributor’s bonded warehouse, and make the deal safe: the plant buys it outright, or borrows it and the late boxes repay the loan. In our thin-stock case, a line stoppage of up to $1.08M becomes a $68,000 swap.

pages.heading: Delay cover now exists, but it pays after the line stops

pages.text: An 11-day delay stays with the assured: excluded by the cargo clauses and inside the TDI deductible. In systemic events, like the 2026 war that [lifted European polypropylene about 115% in ten weeks](https://www.chemorbis.com/en/premium-plastics-news/European-PP-market-slips-from-4-year-highs-as-buyer-resistance-and-imports-trigger-correction/2026/05/13/971616), lenders’ boxes are late too, so we target single-shipment delays. [Marsh](https://www.marsh.com/en/industries/cargo/expertise/parametric-coverage-for-cargo-delay.html)’s parametric cover, built by Lloyd’s Lab alumnus [Otonomi](https://www.lloyds.com/insights/lloyds-lab/programmes-and-initiatives/lloyds-lab-accelerator/alumni/otonomi), pays up to $250,000, but no cover keeps the line running.

pages.heading: A mid-ocean title swap fails on day one; each barrier has a port-side substitute

header: WHY IT BLOCKS AN AT-SEA SWAP
rows: AIS is open, but manifests, bills and certificates of analysis (CoAs) are private. [US manifest data can be bought](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/19/103.31); EU entry data (ICS2) is closed.
We do not scan the sea. We read only our insureds and 3 to 5 distributors, through ERP, TMS or EDI links.
Two plants that never met will not lend each other stock.
One counterparty: a distributor acting as buffer hub, already holding the stock.

[About 12.8% of bills are electronic](https://www.bimco.org/media/25ufac3s/dcsa_fit-alliance-webinar_nov-27-2025.pdf), though [51% of survey respondents use some. Platform fragmentation is their top concern.](https://iccwbo.org/news-publications/news/electronic-bill-of-lading-adoption-grows-as-focus-shifts-to-interoperability/)
Delivery orders and bonded stock at the destination port. eBL is an upgrade where it already exists.
A late consignee change brings fees, customs delays and double-VAT risk.
The plant stays consignee. Boxes change hands under customs suspension, after arrival.
QA approves a plant and a grade, not a CAS number.
Same producer, plant and grade code, for example SABIC PP 575P for SABIC PP 575P.

pages.heading: The late boxes repay a stock loan, and duty is paid once

pages.text: We buy the warning; we do not build it. Container-level tracking from [FourKites](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260504510211/en/), [project44](https://www.project44.com/press-releases/project44-launches-ai-ocean-exceptions-agent-to-autonomously-resolve-rolled-container-disruptions/) or [Kpler](https://www.worldports.org/kpler-completes-acquisition-of-spire-maritime) flags rolled boxes, missed connections and congestion, the causes behind most delays. From a booking number, we compare each new ETA with the plant’s safety stock and alert only when the delay outruns it.

left.text: Bonded stock in Rotterdam or Antwerp

top.title: T: stock goes out on loan
top.text: Alert at T-12, match at T-10, swap bound at T-8. On the original date, the hub releases 40 TEU digitally. The plant clears them in its own name and pays duty and VAT once.

bottom.title: T+11: the late boxes repay the loan
bottom.text: The plant does not clear them. They wait in temporary storage, then move under T1 into the hub’s customs warehouse. Title passes, and duty and VAT stay suspended until the hub sells.
bottom.badge: Proposed wrapper live until the boxes are back

pages.text: T is the late shipment’s scheduled arrival. Day counts come from the illustrative case on page 2, and the 12-day alert is a target.

pages.heading: It runs on procedures ports already use

items: **Release is digital.** [Rotterdam’s Secure Chain](https://breakbulk.news/port-of-rotterdam-ends-use-of-fraud-sensitive-pin-codes-for-container-release/) and [Antwerp](https://en.flows.be/?p=76415) have retired PIN codes, so forwarders and hauliers enroll first.

**Customs stays suspended.** Goods may wait [90 days in temporary storage](https://belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontenten/belastingdienst/customs/customs-processes/temporary-storage-of-goods/temporary-storage-of-goods). [T1](https://flexport.com/glossary/External-Transit-T1) moves them to an approved warehouse, where [duty and VAT stay suspended](https://guichet.public.lu/en/entreprises/import-export/importation/import-depuis-pays-tiers/entrepot-douanier.html) and [rights under the procedure can transfer](https://www.thetradehub.eu/en/reglementation/uk/eu/ucc-952-2013/article/218) to a qualified holder.

**eBL-ready, not eBL-dependent.** An eBL or sea waybill lets the delivery order change 72 hours before berthing. With a to-order eBL, [recognised in Dutch law since July 2026](https://www.iccwbo.nl/news/the-green-light-for-ebls), control can pass to the lender at loan start, as security, for counsel to confirm.

pages.heading: The cover adds only what the cargo policy lacks

pages.text: A distributor lends $1.2M of stock for 11 days only if the return leg is safe. Most of that safety exists already; we add the long stop.

rows: The plant’s cargo policy already insures them at [110% of CIF value](https://www.thetradehub.eu/en/glossary/insurance-obligation). The lender is named loss payee.

Existing cover. [A contingent interest is insurable](https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/1906/en/act/pub/0041/sec0007.html) and [Quadra v XL (2023) needs no title](https://7kbw.co.uk/insurable-interest-in-unascertained-goods), subject to counsel.
The plant’s cargo insurer issues the [average guarantee](https://blogs.tradlinx.com/general-average-explained-why-your-cargo-can-be-held-after-a-ship-casualty/), as it does today.
New: pays an agreed value if the late boxes pass a long-stop date.
The one new risk. Our $16,000 premium is a placeholder.

pages.text: Plant default is credit risk, so it needs a pledge over the trailing cargo or trade credit cover. [Arranging cover is regulated](https://handbook.fca.org.uk/handbook/perg5), so stead.ai would act under a broker or coverholder. No Lloyd’s capacity is committed today.

pages.text: **Our advantage.** We found no one else who finds identical stock before the line stops and makes both routes safe: an outright purchase, or a loan the late boxes repay. [FourKites](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260504510211/en/) and [project44](https://www.project44.com/press-releases/project44-launches-ai-ocean-exceptions-agent-to-autonomously-resolve-rolled-container-disruptions/) warn, without stock or cover.

**For the syndicate.** A new short delay line, about $1.6M of premium per 100 swaps, plus smaller TDI claims: above the deductible, the swap is a [TDI mitigation expense](https://www.aon.com/insights/articles/2022/mitigate-supply-chain-risk-with-trade-disruption-insurance); [ICC Clause 16 cannot fund it](https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/1906/en/act/pub/0041/sec0078.html), because sue and labour reaches only loss the policy covers.

items: **Demand is unproven.** Plants often hold [about 30 days of inventory](https://www.insurancebusinessmag.com/uk/news/sme/businesses-are-carrying-supply-chain-risk-brokers-could-insure-589617.aspx), and sellers carry delays on delivered terms.
**Stock depth and lead time are unmeasured** until a distributor opens its data. Customer interviews come first.

**QA, tax and form vary.** [Some programs need formal approval](https://www.marvalindustries.com/color-compounding-blogs/plastic-resin-suppliers/plastic-resin-suppliers-oems-materials-mid-program.html); [Dutch zero-rating needs proof](https://www.bdo.nl/en-gb/insights/application-of-0-vat-on-goods-not-yet-imported); the swap is two netted sales.

pages.text: **We need** a marine cargo or TDI underwriter, a claims lead, a specialty broker and one distributor. Targets are polymer houses ([Ravago](https://ravago.com/en-BE/markets/polymers), [Biesterfeld](https://www.biesterfeld.com/en/lu/service/competence-in-plastics)) and chemical distributors (Brenntag, Univar, Helm, Barentz). None is a partner yet.

**Team:** Udi Bahat, CEO: lead PM for risk products at PayPal until October 2026, 20+ years in fintech, M.Sc. Computer Science, cum laude. Ronit Oren, PhD, CTO: Cornell PhD and algorithm developer, nearly six years leading product at Wix.
